claims.claim_text: In August 2023, Circle entered into a Collaboration Agreement and an Intellectual Property License Agreement with Coinbase governing USDC distribution and a revenue-share on reserve income; Coinbase is Circle's primary distribution partner and the largest single counterparty driving Circle's distribution costs.
claims.subject: Circle Internet Group
claims.predicate: has revenue-share / distribution Collaboration Agreement with
claims.source_quote: In August 2023, we entered into a Collaboration Agreement (the Collaboration Agreement) and an Intellectual Property License Agreement with Coinbase... we and Coinbase may agree to pay a portion of the residual payment base to approved participants

claims.claim_text: As of March 31, 2025, approximately 90% of USDC reserves were held in the Circle Reserve Fund, a Rule 2a-7 government money market fund managed by BlackRock and available only to Circle.
claims.subject: Circle Reserve Fund
claims.source_quote: we held approximately 90% of USDC reserves in the Circle Reserve Fund, a government money market fund pursuant to Rule 2a-7 ... managed by BlackRock, one of the world's largest asset managers, and available only to us.

claims.claim_text: The assets within the Circle Reserve Fund are held in the custody of The Bank of New York Mellon (BNY), one of the largest asset custodians in the world.
claims.subject: Circle Reserve Fund reserve assets
claims.source_quote: The assets within the Circle Reserve Fund are held in the custody of The Bank of New York Mellon (BNY), one of the largest asset custodians in the world.

claims.claim_text: As of March 31, 2025 there was $60.0 billion of USDC in circulation (USDC in circulation end-of-period $59,976M), with deposits from stablecoin holders / segregated reserve cash of $43.9B at 12/31/2024 rising to $60.1B at 3/31/2025.
claims.subject: USDC in circulation
claims.source_quote: $60.0 billion of USDC in circulation across 4.9 million MeWs as of March 31, 2025 ... Cash and cash equivalents segregated for the benefit of stablecoin holders was ... $60.1 billion as of March 31, 2025.

claims.claim_text: Reserve income comprised between 95% and 99% of Circle's total revenue in 2024, 2023, 2022 and Q1 2025 (i.e. the business is almost entirely a function of interest earned on USDC reserve assets at a discount to SOFR).
claims.subject: Circle reserve income
claims.source_quote: Reserve income comprised between 95% and 99% of our total revenue in the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023, and 2022 and in the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024.

claims.claim_text: In July 2024 Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS became the first global stablecoin issuer to achieve compliance with MiCAR (EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation), issuing USDC and EURC into the EU under that regime.
claims.subject: Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS
claims.object_value: MiCAR (EU) — first global stablecoin issuer, July 2024
claims.source_quote: In July 2024, Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS became the first global stablecoin issuer to achieve compliance with MiCAR.

claims.claim_text: In January 2025 Circle acquired Hashnote and now issues USYC, a leading tokenized money market fund (TMMF); the acquisition added $96.5M of goodwill recognized in Q1 2025.
claims.subject: Circle
claims.source_quote: As a result of our acquisition of Hashnote in January 2025, we issue USYC a leading TMMF ... Goodwill increased by $96.5 million ... primarily due to the recognition of $96.5 million of goodwill related to the Hashnote acquisition.
